text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Safety is of key importance to DETEC.", "gist": "Safety is very important for DETEC."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Safety Office", "gist": "An office responsible for safety"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "to ensure safety across a wide range of areas", "gist": "The Safety Office must ensure safety in many areas"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It supports the further development of safety in land, sea and air transport, in the use, transport and distribution of energy, and for communications infrastructures.", "gist": "The Safety Office supports improving safety in transport and energy sectors and communications infrastructures"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2003", "gist": "The year when DETEC created the Civil Aviation Safety Office"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Civil Aviation Safety Office (CASO)", "gist": "A specific office within DETEC"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "to establish the highest possible safety standards in Swiss civil aviation", "gist": "CASO must set the highest safety standards for Swiss civil aviation"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "The mandate was later extended to rail transport and ship navigation", "gist": "CASO's mandate was expanded to include rail transport and ship navigation"}]}
